# Warranty Tracker Skill

This skill keeps every device warranty in one place, with its end date and receipt. Give the device, the purchase date, and the warranty terms, and get a tracker that flags what expires soon, what is still covered, and which receipt to show. It stops you from paying for a repair that is already covered.
